primary_records.source_locator: ISA DMS 6.0r12 §3.3 Adjust Brightness, printed pp.23–23 / PDF pp.38–38
primary_records.original_meaning: Declares a rate-based brightness adjustment. POSITIVE means increase brightness; NEGATIVE means decrease brightness. The entry describes motion/change toward the named setting limits (100% and 0%) until stopped, limited by duration, or superseded. Optional rate defaults to 100% of the component maximum rate of change.
primary_records.mapping_boundary: A command specification/request role, not proof of invocation, acknowledgement, execution success or a changed measured property. Rate is a percent of maximum adjustment speed, not the target value or a physical-unit rate. A direction and duration-zero stop do not establish an executed stop. No command-specific Results table is declared in this entry; this does not mean the enclosing protocol has no response or status.
